item.title: Josh Davison joins Cheltenham Town on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Josh Davison has joined Cheltenham Town on loan until the end of the 2025/26 season. Davison, 26, signed for Rovers in the summer of 2024 and has scored seven goals in 67 appearances, including strikes in our 4-0 victory over Shrewsbury Town and 4-1 win at Bristol Rovers this season. Everyone at the Club would like to thank Josh for his contribution and wish him all the best at Cheltenham.

item.title: James Plant signs for Tranmere Rovers on an 18-month deal
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are delighted to announce the signing of James Plant from League One Port Vale on an 18-month deal. Plant, 21, has made almost half a century of appearances for Vale, having also spent time on loan at Nantwich Town and Salisbury before making his Football League debut, and has featured for Yeovil Town in the National League. item.description: Our postponed fixture at Newport County has been rearranged for Tuesday 3rd March 2026 and a 7.45pm kick-off. Ticket and coach travel details to follow.

item.title: Connor Jennings Update
item.description: The Club can confirm that Connor Jennings has suffered an ACL, MCL, and meniscus injury, which will keep him out for a long period of time. Connor will have the Club’s full support through his rehabilitation and we are pleased he has today agreed and signed a new one-year extension to his contract. We’re all with you, Jenno.
